import "date"

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 7d, from: v.timeRangeStart), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.entity_id == "${entity_prefix}${inverter}_load_total_power" or
    r.entity_id == "${entity_prefix}${inverter}_grid_total_power" or
    r.entity_id == "${entity_prefix}${inverter}_pv_total_power"
  )
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(column: "_value", usePrevious: true)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time >= v.timeRangeStart)

import "date"

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 7d, from: v.timeRangeStart), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.entity_id == "${entity_prefix}${inverter}_battery_power")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: -1.0 * float(v: r._value) }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(column: "_value", usePrevious: true)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time >= v.timeRangeStart)
